sources.title: Independent bounded CPU probes and original-record recomputation
Exact edit-distance lower bound and negation counterexample
sources.details: Reference characters are 請 推 薦 不 辣 的 晚 餐 。 (9); recognized string omits 不 (8). Any edit sequence needs at least abs(9−8)=1 operation. Insert 不 at index 3 to recover the reference in one operation, proving minimum distance 1, hence CER=1/9 and 100/9%=11.111…%, round(...,1)=11.1. Corrected reference equals original, so zero edits/9=0. The conditions 不辣 and 辣 differ in whether spicy food is acceptable; edit count alone cannot determine task adequacy.
